artworks.title: I Love Bad Bitches Banner
artworks.description: This design was inspired by my sister's love as A$AP Rocky when she was a 17 year old girl. It is a felt and cotton fabric banner entirely handstitched with small beaded details, a solid border, and hanging loops on the back.

artworks.title: Very Hungry Boy Card
artworks.description: The perfect birthday card for the very hungry kid in your life. This digitally illustrated card will be customized with the face of your little loved one. Comes with a matching envelope liner!

artworks.title: Just Like Butter Wedding Banner
artworks.description: This felt and cotton fabric banner was a wedding gift for friends who described their relationship like butter melting into mashed potatoes-a beautiful amalgamation of souls. I can include names and/or date for an additional $20.

artworks.title: Camp Banner
artworks.description: My friends had a camp themed bachelorette party and I crafted this banner to help celebrate! I thrifted that beautiful green material for the base and handstitched every felt piece and bead on top. The disco ball, stars, and beadwork are optional for an additional $20.

artworks.title: Name Banner
artworks.description: Handstitched felt name sign for your kiddo's room. You can pick colors from my felt library to completely customize the banner, or I'd love to surprise you with the final design. Ribbon adornment available for $5 and star additions are available for $10.

artworks.title: Sophie Name Banner
artworks.description: Whimsical felt name banner with peach letters on navy, yellow zigzag-stitched borders, and dangling hearts and stars on lavender ribbon. A sweet personalized touch for any child's space.

artworks.title: Handmade Pride Cards
artworks.description: Set of four hand-drawn greeting cards including an "I Love You" heart design and three Pride-themed cards with bold marker illustrations, wavy patterns, and floral motifs on colorful cardstock.

artworks.title: Block-Print Thank You Cards
artworks.description: Artisan block-printed "Thank You!" cards on handmade textured paper with stylized floral motifs. Available in multiple colorways including emerald on blush, indigo on cream, and crimson on rust.

artworks.title: Witchy Birthday Card
artworks.description: Whimsical birthday card featuring three witches dancing around a campfire under a full moon. Includes a purple envelope with a Halloween-patterned liner and a gold wax seal.

artworks.title: Jazzed Engagement Card
artworks.description: Playful hand-illustrated engagement card with jazz instruments — trumpet, saxophone, and clarinet — on a soft blue background. Reads "I'm so jazzed that you're engaged!" Includes a bright yellow envelope.

artworks.title: Happy New Home Card
artworks.description: Cozy new home greeting card with a hand-drawn illustration of someone reading on a sofa with their puppy. Comes with a deep purple envelope lined with an adorable puppy pattern.

artworks.title: We Do Wedding Card
artworks.description: Romantic watercolor-style illustration of two hands clinking gold-rimmed wine glasses beneath elegant "We do." script on a soft blue background. Perfect for weddings and anniversaries.

artworks.title: Moon & Stars Wedding Card
artworks.description: Hand-painted celestial greeting card on black cardstock with a crescent moon, golden stars, and clouds. Reads "the moon and stars aligned to bring you two together." Includes a golden envelope with a hand-painted sky liner.

artworks.title: Cardinal Anniversary Card
artworks.description: Hand-painted cardinal greeting card on black cardstock with a cardinal bird, golden stars, and clouds. Reads "the moon and stars aligned to bring you two together." Includes a golden envelope with a hand-painted sky liner.
